answer: Proof of Stake acts as a formidable tide against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment to validate network transitions. An attacker must acquire a majority of staked onyx assets, which mimics the structural complexity of a sonnet where every component is codependent, to seize control. The cost is prohibitive, as the market price of the stake would collapse upon such a hostile acquisition, rendering the attempt economically irrational and ensuring the integrity of the agent economy.
